name: Buttercup
source: Buttercup is a spirited witch-in-training making her first tentative steps into the human world. Raised among gnomes in the wild, she’s still mastering her magic but is eager to settle down and expand her abilities. A curious party girl with a healthy dose of suspicion, Buttercup is fascinated by human customs while remaining loyal to her gnome roots. Though generally unflappable, she’s occasionally thrown off by the oddities of her new environment.
